answer: BASS-II is the nearest solid-fuel evidence, but its curated initial oxygen range is 0.136–0.222, so it does not cover 30% O2. No completed PSI record covers the solid-fuel, 30% O2, 8.2 psia, partial-gravity combination; the scenario flow value is also unspecified.
